data.narrative:
Stark Defence is a Series A defense and security company founded by Florian Seibel, Uwe Horstmann, and Johannes Schaback. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables spanning both public equities (2 names: DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and private capital (8 names including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and others).

Stage-progression methodology was inapplicable: the stated post-money valuation of $4.0B implies an $8.0B forward value at Series B, which exceeds the company's total $100M+ raised by more than 20x and signals a likely data-quality issue. Peer-median triangulation is therefore the primary method. Across the 10-company comparables set, valuations ranged from $125M to $3.0B, with a median of $1.0B. This reflects representative peers such as Castelion and Defense Unicorns (both $1.0B at Series B) and higher performers including Harmattan AI ($1.4B) and Dream Security ($3.0B).

The analysis supports a valuation range of $850M to $1.1B, centered on a $1.0B median. Key uncertainties stem from the limited dataset depth (one triangulation method only) and peer heterogeneity within the defense tech sector, where stage-to-stage value expansion varies materially. Further revenue, growth rate, and technology differentiation data would reduce range width.
